app_info.subtitle: Honey export release checks
app_info.description: BeeTrust coordinates laboratory fingerprint evidence, tamper-evident custody, New Zealand MPI market-access checks, customs preparation, and controlled red-team testing before producing a RELEASE, REVIEW, or BLOCKED decision. It is decision support for exporters, brokers, compliance teams, and audit reviewers; it does not issue certificates or replace professional judgement.

test_cases.description: Run the supported Australia release workflow across orchestration, evidence, custody, market access, customs, adversarial testing, and final monitoring.
test_cases.user_prompt: Release 1000 jars of UMF Mānuka honey from New Zealand to Australia for AU retail review.
test_cases.tools_triggered: Skill: orchestration-hub → fingerprint-evidence, custody-ledger, mpi-market-access, customs-clearance, trade-risk-adversary, evidence-monitor
test_cases.expected_output: A TaskPlan and SkillMessage/v1 lifecycle trace ending in a baseline RELEASE decision, with evidence references and six controlled red-team scenarios that remain BLOCKED.

test_cases.description: Validate a laboratory fingerprint against the versioned reference profile and apply the release thresholds.
test_cases.user_prompt: Compare the LAB_CSV against the reference batch and report similarity, confidence, and anomalies.
test_cases.expected_output: A structured PASS result with similarity, confidence, anomalies, and evidence references when the supplied fixture matches the reference.

test_cases.description: Verify the ordered farm, processor, warehouse, and carrier custody events using the tamper-evident hash chain.
test_cases.user_prompt: Run a tamper check on the custody ledger for the harvest and processor events.
test_cases.expected_output: A structured PASS result with event hashes, previousHash values, a final headHash, and zero tampered event IDs.

test_cases.description: Check the supported Australia market-access evidence, including MPI rule version, RMP, OMAR, certificate, and freshness requirements.
test_cases.user_prompt: Check MPI market access and OMAR evidence for Australia.
test_cases.expected_output: A structured PASS result with destination Australia, an empty missingEvidence list, the active ruleVersion, and evidence references.

test_cases.description: Prepare a candidate customs classification, transparent landed-value estimate, and draft commercial documents without submitting anything to TSW.
test_cases.user_prompt: Prepare the HS_CODE candidate and PACKING_LIST draft for 1000 jars of UMF Mānuka honey to Australia.
test_cases.expected_output: A structured PASS or REVIEW result containing an HS candidate including 0409.00, landedValueNzd, document drafts, validation issues, and evidence references.

negative_test_cases.description: Reject malformed laboratory input without inventing marker values or issuing a pass.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Compare this laboratory result: not a laboratory payload.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app returns a safe BLOCKED result with a validation finding and no fabricated confidence claim.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not infer market-access rules for a destination without a verified rule snapshot.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Release 1000 jars of UMF Mānuka honey from New Zealand to an unsupported destination market.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app returns BLOCKED with the unsupported destination and a missing-rule finding instead of proceeding.

negative_test_cases.description: Preserve the baseline and block a cloned case when a controlled custody fault is injected.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Run the controlled custody-batch-tampering red-team rehearsal and report the release decision.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The cloned scenario returns BLOCKED with an active custody finding, while the untouched baseline remains RELEASE.
